_about: Public-domain Francis Gastrell (1662-1725), Bishop of Chester, for the Word Hoard: The Certainty of the Christian Revelation, The Certainty and Necessity of Religion (his Boyle Lectures), The Christian Institutes, and his 1707 charity-school sermon. His anonymous books (Some Considerations concerning the Trinity and its Defence, The Principles of Deism, the Remarks upon Clarke, A Moral Proof of a Future State) are held until Adam rules on catalogue attributions. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 135 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
